instruction: Create the final edited image. This is a strict compositing and typesetting task, not a redesign.

input_order.image_1: LOCKED Layout 3 template containing the white numeral 3 and placeholder text on black.
input_order.image_2: Dynamic blended interior photo used as the full-bleed background and as the only source for the written tip.

objective: Replace the black background of Image 1 with Image 2 and replace only the placeholder wording with one contextual tip. The final result must look like the same Layout 3 template laid over a new photograph. Do not reinterpret, modernize, or redesign the template.

template_lock.instruction: Treat Image 1 as an exact registration guide and reusable overlay, not merely as style inspiration.
template_lock.number_3: Keep the existing white numeral 3 as a locked graphic. Preserve its exact glyph silhouette, thin stroke weight, proportions, size, position, baseline, and orientation. Prefer retaining/compositing its original pixels instead of redrawing it.
template_lock.text_box: Use the exact placeholder text bounding box from Image 1. Keep its left edge, right edge, top edge, width, baseline rhythm, and relationship to the numeral 3.
template_lock.allowed_changes: Only the black pixels behind the layout and the placeholder words may change.
template_lock.forbidden_changes: Do not move, center, enlarge, shrink, thicken, distort, rotate, recolor, restyle, or regenerate the numeral 3. Do not move or center the text block.

typography_lock.font_family: Match the template's neutral modern neo-grotesk sans-serif exactly; Helvetica Neue or Neue Haas Grotesk appearance. Do not use a rounded, geometric, condensed, serif, handwritten, display, or decorative font.
typography_lock.number_weight: Thin/Light, approximately 300, exactly matching the template numeral.
typography_lock.tip_weight: Regular, approximately 400, exactly matching the placeholder's clean editorial typography.
typography_lock.alignment: Strictly left-aligned. Never center-align, right-align, justify, curve, stagger, or individually center the lines.
typography_lock.letter_spacing: Neutral, tight professional tracking; do not spread letters apart.
typography_lock.line_height: Compact editorial leading, approximately 0.92 to 1.0 times the text size. Do not use loose line spacing.
typography_lock.scale: Match the template text size. The tip must remain clearly smaller than the numeral 3.
typography_lock.effects: No outline, glow, bevel, extrusion, colored stroke, or heavy drop shadow.

tip_generation.instruction: Analyze only Image 2 and write one original, practical interior-design tip supported by visible details in that photo.
tip_generation.length: Use 9 to 16 words, excluding the numeral 3. Prefer one sentence that wraps into exactly 3 or 4 balanced lines inside the locked text box.
tip_generation.wrapping: Create editorial line breaks similar to the reference: balanced left-aligned lines, approximately 18 to 30 characters per line when possible. Do not create a tall narrow stack of short centered lines.
tip_generation.tone: Premium, specific, helpful, natural, and concise.
tip_generation.accuracy: Mention only visible furniture, lighting, color, scale, material, placement, or styling. Do not invent details.
tip_generation.prohibited_copy: Never output the placeholder phrase, brackets, meta-instructions, labels, headings, hashtags, quotation marks, or the words 'according to the photo'.

background.coverage: Use Image 2 edge to edge and fill the entire 9:16 canvas with no black border.
background.preserve: Keep its main lighting fixture, furniture, architecture, materials, colors, perspective, lighting, shadows, and photorealism accurate.
background.crop: Crop only as needed while keeping the main subject fully recognizable and leaving a readable lower-left typography area.
background.readability: A subtle bottom-to-transparent dark gradient or very soft localized shadow is allowed behind the lower text only. Keep the photo visible; never add a solid or large opaque black panel.

final_check: Before output, verify that the original numeral 3 still looks pixel-identical to Image 1; the tip is left-aligned immediately to its right in the original text box; the font family, weights, size, leading, and white color match the template; the tip is 3 or 4 balanced lines; and Image 2 fills the 9:16 background.

output.quality: photorealistic background with crisp, correctly spelled typography
